policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: The printability and mechanical integrity of polycarbonate are governed by a coupled thermal-kinetic matrix where nozzle temperature and extrusion velocity determine the rate of crystallization and adhesion between layers, and this sensitivity is exacerbated when the part bed or ambient temperature exceeds specific thresholds, leading to delamination or layer skipping if the cooling profile is insufficient.
ranked.intervention: Implement a closed-loop active cooling system that maintains the build platform and immediate surrounding ambient temperature below 35C, or increase the nozzle temperature and reduce the extrusion velocity (increase dwell time) to compensate for the higher baseline thermal energy, ensuring the thermal budget allows for proper interlayer fusion without premature solidification or delamination.

ranked.mechanism: The use of a two-temperature stage extruder to maintain high polymer viscosity and prevent premature cooling in high-performance polycarbonate
ranked.intervention: Equip the 3D printer with a dual-zone heated nozzle and chamber insulation to ensure the second heating zone maintains polycarbonate above its glass transition temperature during layer deposition

ranked.mechanism: Thermal stabilization of high-performance polycarbonate during extrusion via optimized temperature and nozzle velocity to ensure proper material flow and mechanical bonding.
ranked.intervention: Adjust the print bed temperature to be significantly higher than the 35C ambient threshold (e.g., 80-100C) and calibrate the nozzle velocity to maintain optimal polycarbonate rheology.

ranked.mechanism: Two-temperature stage extruder maintains elevated melt/feed temperature to keep polycarbonate above its heat-resistant processing window, preventing premature cooling and loss of inter-layer bonding when ambient conditions approach PC's heat-distortion limit.
ranked.intervention: Replace the single-zone hot end with a two-temperature stage extruder for PC, setting the upstream/feed zone to a temperature tuned to keep the melt above the threshold where layer adhesion fails above 35C ambient; monitor and record a single measurement — the inter-layer weld/interface temperature (or equivalently the extrudate surface temperature at deposition) — as the settlement metric.
